name: Art of This Century gallery opens
shortDescription: Guggenheim opens her New York gallery, staging Surrealist and emerging American art side by side.
description: Designed with theatrical, curved walls by Frederick Kiesler, Art of This Century became the New York meeting point for European Surrealists in exile and the young American painters Guggenheim was starting to champion.

appearances.context: The gallery's design, opening night, and the artists it brought together.
